provenance: Three newly authored screenplay–video prompt pairs, held separate from the original T01–T15 labels.
important_note: Manual expected labels and fixture replies. They are NOT Gemini predictions or independently adjudicated model accuracy measurements.

cases.scenario: Unseen paper-boat action with equivalent wording

input.screenplay_text: Farah folds a paper boat and floats it in a rain puddle.
input.video_prompt: Farah makes a small paper boat and sets it afloat in a rain puddle, overcast light.
input.shot_intent: Show Farah launching her paper boat into the puddle.

facts.required_detail: Farah makes and floats a paper boat in a puddle.
facts.source_evidence: Farah folds a paper boat and floats it in a rain puddle
facts.applicability_reason: The boat launch is exactly the action shot's subject.

expected.suggested_corrected_prompt: Farah makes a small paper boat and sets it afloat in a rain puddle, overcast light.

cases.scenario: Unseen steel hatch action reversed around ladder climb

input.screenplay_text: At the rooftop, Dev closes the steel hatch before Nisha climbs the ladder.
input.video_prompt: Nisha climbs the ladder first; then Dev shuts the steel hatch, harsh noon sun.
input.shot_intent: Show the hatch closure before Nisha's ladder climb.

facts.required_detail: Dev closes the hatch before Nisha climbs.
facts.source_evidence: Dev closes the steel hatch before Nisha climbs the ladder
facts.applicability_reason: Both actions and their order are required in this shot.

findings.screenplay_evidence: Dev closes the steel hatch before Nisha climbs the ladder
findings.prompt_evidence: Nisha climbs the ladder first; then Dev shuts the steel hatch
findings.explanation: The prompt reverses the explicit temporal order of two required actions.
findings.suggested_fix: Have Dev close the hatch before Nisha climbs the ladder.

expected.suggested_corrected_prompt: Dev shuts the steel hatch; then Nisha climbs the ladder, harsh noon sun.

cases.scenario: Unseen Hindi screenplay with unnamed English character

input.screenplay_text: मीरा अपनी चांदी की पायल बाँधती है, फिर चौखट पर रुकती है।
input.video_prompt: A woman fastens a silver anklet, then pauses at the doorway. Soft morning light.
input.shot_intent: Show the character Meera herself wearing the anklet.

facts.required_detail: The woman attaching the silver anklet must be Meera.
facts.source_evidence: मीरा अपनी चांदी की पायल बाँधती है
facts.applicability_reason: Character identity is part of the shot's intent.
facts.uncertainty_note: The prompt does not name the woman.

findings.screenplay_evidence: मीरा अपनी चांदी की पायल बाँधती है
findings.explanation: The action matches, but the unnamed woman's identity cannot be confirmed as Meera.
findings.suggested_fix: Ask whether the woman is Meera; specify her name only after confirmation.

expected.suggested_corrected_prompt: A woman fastens a silver anklet, then pauses at the doorway. Soft morning light.
